Latest quarter Sep 2026: Excellent (sales +33% YoY, profit +56% YoY)
FIIs (foreign funds) raised holding by 3.4 pts in a year
Cost quality excellent: costs falling, margin expanding, operating profit growing (costs 82% to 80% of sales)
Profits backed by cash: operating cash flow is 144% of 3-year profit
Vendor-qualification / long-term-agreement language on the concall
Sector cycle: Earnings improving but price not confirming
risks: Working capital stretching - debtor days 56 to 70, inventory days 145 to 170 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Domestic institutions (mutual funds, insurers) cut holding by 7.4 pts in a year
Shareholder count up 53% in a year - retail crowding in

order_book: Elevated order backlogs and lean dealer inventories, with demand still running ahead of the supply, give us good visibility into quarter three FY 2027.
Our order book as on September 30, 2026, which is the peak annual revenues of the sale of new businesses, excluding ADS, stands at INR 22,410 million.
guidance: Auto ICE now accounts for about 65% of our sales on a much l arger base, broadly in line with the target we set ourselves at the time of our IPO.
With the new SKUs coming on stream in the ADS business in H2 FY 2027, we expect a strong growth catalyst that should accelerate our momentum through the second half.
capex: Depreciation rose 20% to INR 602 million, and finance cost to INR 146 million from INR 81 million, reflecting our expanded asset base and higher borrowing cost for capex and working capital.
Against this, an investment was made of about INR 3,260 million in the Capex for automotive and ADS business.
risks: These statements are not the guarantees of future performance and involve risks and uncertainties that are difficult to predict.
Additionally, the revision in minimum wages in Karnataka added to the cost pressures, further impacting our margins.
focus: This is a clear sign of how far we have come in building Sansera into a diversified company with multiple growth engines, and our non-automotive business has been a center to this transformation.
We see this as the beginning, not the end of our diversification journey.
We will continue to add new sectors, new customers, deepen our wallet share with existing ones, and move up the value chain.
